definitions: In actual existence or reality, as opposed to in a fictional work, on the internet, or in an idealized or hypothetical situation.
Used to distinguish between an online persona or interaction and a person's actual physical presence or circumstances.
examples: She's much taller in real life than she appears on screen.
I met my online friend in real life last weekend.
The character is a hero in the movie, but in real life, he's quite ordinary.
